records.title: PROGRESS OF DIGITAL INDIA PROGRAMME
details: (a) to (c): It was inter-alia stated that Accordingly, Department of Higher Education, M/o Education has approved grant of Rs. 2 crore to each consortium to provide detailed problem statement and proof of concept (PoC) within a time period of 6 months. Thereafter 3 consortiums will be finalised to be established as Centres of Excellence (one in each domain) under phase-II.
